cage._note: Xenosaurid cages (XenoCages): stageSeconds to be opened or you die; the maxCaptures-th capture kills; a teammate opens the gate with a lockpick (pickSeconds, quiet, can snap) or the cube held out at chargeCost% (chargeSeconds, loud, charge spent); for freeGrace s after a cage opens it leaves anyone within freeGraceRange m alone.

cube._note: The cube stun (XenoClimber): Use with stunMinCharge% or more, aimed at the Xenosaurid (stunAngle deg) within stunRange m, spends stunCost%: carrying someone it drops them, else it is stunned stunSeconds.

guided._note: Guided first raid: real items a player can take from its containers per session, first time through only.

ambience._note: RaidAmbience (Docs/SOUNDS.md plan): beds start at startLevel x cap and rise over rampSeconds to cap; Emergency Stairwell in stair shafts, Utility Level below basementBelowY; chase music while an apex chases within chaseRange m (lingers chaseLinger s); Tense Full Mix in the squeeze; madhouse under madhouseBelow sanity. All x the ambience volume setting.

squeeze._note: Closing out long runs. From enrageSeconds left the evac siren sounds: the apex stays at full anger and wakes even if the power never came on (a shock mine only stands the Xenosaurid up for standSeconds, flares burn flareSeconds). Time's up = overtimeSeconds more, where an apex hit kills; then the run ends.

achievements._note: Achievements (Docs/ACHIEVEMENTS.md, v2). stat = counter, all = every listed counter >= the tier, max = highest value (not a sum). Counters bank on escape unless any = true. titles[t] = the title tier t+1 gives ("" = none): the early tiers give plain ones, the top tier the cool one. xp per tier = 60 x diff x (1,2,4,8,15 for five tiers; 1,3,6,12 four; 1,3,8 three; 2,6 two; 6 one), rounded to 10. cat = the icon on its card (escaping, apex, combat, medic, looting, progress).

loot._note: Share drops ON: a drop is yours alone dropLockSeconds (then also until your save no longer has it - anti-dupe); OFF: keepDropsSeconds. Default was 15 s; the user: a friend could not pick up a shared drop.

wrist._note: VR wrist hologram (WristStatus): off = where it sits from the hand (hand space, m); back = the back-of-hand axis in hand space (it rises along it); lookAngle = how close to it you must look (deg); faceDot > 0 also needs the back of the hand turned toward your eyes (0.3 = roughly facing).

vr._note: VR point-to-pocket aim (PointPocket): pitch / yaw on the hand tracking rotation, cone in degrees; pointDebug 1 = debug users always see the aim beam.

avatar._note: Allowed avatar eye-height range (m), kept tight (1.6-1.8) so grabs, seats and the execution line up; animations aim at apex.execEyeHeight (1.7). VRChat scales anyone outside it into range, so body zones (hip ring, stow zones, wrist) stay reachable. freeUsers (VRChat display names, exact) get the full 0.2-5 m range.

apex_crate._note: Hazard crates (ApexCrates): power.apexCrates of the map's ApexCrateSpot candidates show per raid, open from the raid start (an emptied one can be charged again: hazardCrates). They roll only this raid's apex counter item: apexItems.<slot> (0 Hollowface, 1 Xenosaurid).

locker._note: Most lockers are locked: pickOnly / pryOnly = odds a locked one takes only a pick (padlock) or only a crowbar (jammed); the rest take either. Slightly better loot than crates.

vault._note: Power-on secure caches (SecureRooms): only in the picked rooms, only after the generator's running - so no lock of their own. Rich on purpose; weight and space are the limit.

husk._note: What a killed husk can drop (enemies.husk.dropChance): monster parts (rotten meat common, husk samples uncommon) for quests/trading, now and then a valuable they still had on them. No medical, food or materials - corpses aren't supply crates.

training_lockbox._note: Training wing: locked; the lock bonus roll gives the crowbar.

training_prybox._note: Training wing: locked; a bandage (+1 from the lock bonus).

guided_crate._note: Guided first raid (per player, training-style). First time through the finds are real (at most guided.realItems), replays training items. always: one item every guided container holds (something worth putting in SECURE).

secure_case._note: The good hard cases (SecureCases picker; SecureCaseSpot_n candidates in Riverside). Every raid shows perRaidMin..perRaidMax of them, power or not. Always locked, lockpick only; rolls lean rare.

crate_spots._note: Not a loot table: the share of Riverside's 521 loot crate candidates (CrateSpot_n, about 5 per room) switched on each raid by the CrateSpots picker (SecureCases.cs, table crate_spots), +-15% per raid: about 130 crates, a different set every run.

floorLoot._note: A sparse handful of loose items per run on the map's FloorLoot spots (one per spot). Same rarity bias / tag affinity as containers.

exo_lifter.name: Lifter Exosuit
exo_lifter.desc: An industrial frame: a back battery, arm assist and leg struts. You carry a lot more and tire less, but it isn't quiet.

exo_lifter_armored.name: Armoured Lifter
exo_lifter_armored.desc: The Lifter frame under curved plates. It covers your chest, arms and legs where your own armour doesn't, and it wears like armour does.

exo_cell.name: Exo Cell
exo_cell.desc: A fresh battery for an exosuit. Swap it in when the suit runs low; at the outpost the charger tops it up for free.

seal_residue.name: Seal Residue
seal_residue.desc: What's left in a seal when it shuts. Cold to the touch. The workbench takes it for its best work.

apex_fragment.name: Apex Fragment
apex_fragment.desc: A shard of something the Longskull shed, found in hazard crates. Rare, heavy for its size, and wanted for the best outpost upgrades.

scrap_metal.name: Scrap Metal
scrap_metal.desc: Bent sheet and offcuts. Crafting staple.

bolt.name: Bolts & Screws
bolt.desc: A jar's worth of nuts and bolts. Crafting.

cloth.name: Cloth
cloth.desc: Torn fabric. Bandages and padding are made from it.

duct_tape.name: Duct Tape
duct_tape.desc: Fixes most things, for a while. Crafting.

rope.name: Rope
rope.desc: A coil of nylon rope. Crafting.

batteries.name: Batteries
batteries.desc: Loose cells, mostly charged. Electrics and crafting.

toolbox.name: Toolbox
toolbox.desc: A rusty box of hand tools. Valuable crafting material.

electronics.name: Electronics
electronics.desc: Circuit boards and chips. Advanced crafting.

ceramic_plate.name: Ceramic Plate
ceramic_plate.desc: An armour insert. Top-tier armour crafting.

rotten_meat.name: Spoiled Meat
rotten_meat.desc: Four years in a dead cold store. It reeks. Dell wants bait.

husk_sample.name: Resin Sample
husk_sample.desc: Pale resin scraped off a cage or a vent rim. Still faintly warm. Doc wants it; so does Continuity.

cigarettes.name: Cigarettes
cigarettes.desc: A crumpled pack. Calms the nerves; also sells.

old_coins.name: Old Coins
old_coins.desc: Pre-collapse coins. Sell at the trader.

wristwatch.name: Wristwatch
wristwatch.desc: Still ticking. Sell at the trader.

silverware.name: Silverware
silverware.desc: Tarnished silver cutlery. Sell at the trader.

perfume.name: Perfume
perfume.desc: Sealed designer bottle. Sell at the trader.

wedding_ring.name: Wedding Ring
wedding_ring.desc: Somebody's promise. Sell at the trader.

vintage_camera.name: Vintage Camera
vintage_camera.desc: A collector's piece. Sell at the trader.

whiskey.name: Sealed Whiskey
whiskey.desc: Sealed, aged. A long drink steadies you; worth a lot too.

gold_chain.name: Gold Chain
gold_chain.desc: Heavy gold chain. Sell at the trader.

jewelry_box.name: Jewelry Box
jewelry_box.desc: A locked box of jewellery. Sell at the trader.

gold_bar.name: Gold Bar
gold_bar.desc: 12.5 kg of gold. Too heavy for the vent.

diamond.name: Diamond
diamond.desc: Flawless. The best thing you'll find down here.

bandage.name: Bandage
bandage.desc: Wrap a wound to stop bleeding.

splint.name: Splint
splint.desc: Brace a broken limb so you can use it again.

painkillers.name: Painkillers
painkillers.desc: Dulls pain: fractures stop slowing you for a while.

medkit.name: Medkit
medkit.desc: Field kit: on yourself it makes you healthy again after a hit, and stops all bleeding. On a teammate: stops bleeding and patches them up.

syringe.name: Syringe
syringe.desc: Adrenaline. Gets a downed teammate back on their feet.

surgical_kit.name: Surgical Kit
surgical_kit.desc: Field surgery: repairs serious limb damage and makes you healthy again; for 2 minutes the next hit that would down you only hurts.

soda.name: Soda
soda.desc: Flat but sweet. Calms you a little.

padded_cap.name: Padded Cap
padded_cap.desc: A thick knit cap. Light head protection.

riot_helmet.name: Riot Helmet
riot_helmet.desc: Police riot helmet. Strong head protection.

combat_helmet.name: Combat Helmet
combat_helmet.desc: Military helmet. The best head protection, with a mount for a headlamp.

headlamp.name: Headlamp
headlamp.desc: Head-mounted light. Keeps your hands free. Mounts on a combat helmet (MOUNT slot).

scrap_vest.name: Scrap Plate Vest
scrap_vest.desc: Scrap plates riveted together. Stops claws, but it's heavy going.

vest.name: Police Vest
vest.desc: Soft armour vest with one plate: once a raid it takes a hit that would down you.

plate_carrier.name: Plate Carrier
plate_carrier.desc: Military plates: once a raid they take a hit that would down you. The best torso protection; slows you down.

scavenger_gloves.name: Scavenger's Gloves
scavenger_gloves.desc: Thin and grippy. You search 20% faster, but they'll stop next to nothing.

locksmith_gloves.name: Locksmith's Gloves
locksmith_gloves.desc: Fingertips cut away. A wider pick zone and quicker hands - and no protection at all.

combat_boots.name: Combat Boots
combat_boots.desc: Heavy boots. Leg protection, but loud on concrete.

sling_bag.name: Sling Bag
sling_bag.desc: A small shoulder bag. A few extra slots.

hiking_pack.name: Hiking Pack
hiking_pack.desc: Framed hiking pack. Lots of slots.

rucksack.name: Rucksack
rucksack.desc: Military rucksack. The most slots and carry weight, but bulky and noisy.

flashlight.name: Flashlight
flashlight.desc: A solid metal torch. Clips into your LIGHT slot.

fuel_cylinder.name: Fuel Cylinder
fuel_cylinder.desc: Full of diesel. Carry it to the generator and pour it in. Heavy.

hatch_key.name: Hatch Key
hatch_key.desc: Opens this run's live escape hatch.

knife.name: Knife
knife.desc: Your starter blade. Quick and quiet. Melee slot.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.desc: Heavy and slow, it hits hard. Pries any lock open, loudly. Melee slot.

cheap_flashlight.name: Cheap Flashlight
cheap_flashlight.desc: Plastic torch. Clips into your LIGHT slot.

screwdriver.name: Screwdriver
screwdriver.desc: A proper tool, not a pick. Worth keeping: it sells well, and with Jury-Rig (Mechanic) it pries what a crowbar would.

lockpick.name: Cheap Lockpick
lockpick.desc: Picks locks (skill check). Cheap and thin: a botched pick can snap it.
lockpick._iconNote: PLACEHOLDER: reuses the screwdriver icon and a plain shape until a lockpick model / icon exists

shock_mine.name: Shock Mine
shock_mine.desc: Use it to set it at your feet. When the crawling Xenosaurid runs over it, the shock knocks it up onto its feet - it can only walk for a few minutes. One use. Only found in the hazard crates that unlock when the power comes on; worthless to the trader.

flare.name: Flare
flare.desc: Use it to light it at your feet. For 20 seconds Hollowface won't come within 5 m of it - it leaves anyone in the light alone and backs away. One use. Only found in the hazard crates that unlock when the power comes on; worthless to the trader.

tactical_flashlight.name: Tactical Flashlight
tactical_flashlight.desc: A machined aluminium torch with a tight, bright beam that reaches much further than a cheap light, and it never cuts out.

bow.name: Recurve Bow
bow.desc: A walnut-and-laminate recurve. Hold it, pull the string back with your other hand (desktop: hold the click), let go to shoot. Draws arrows from your pockets. TESTING: dev-only for now.
bow._bowNote: BowController: speed lerps speedMin..speedMax with draw^1.2 (m/s), gravity x 9.81, damage damageMin..damageMax with draw^2, x headMul above the husk's 1.45 m. drawSeconds = desktop full draw. grabReach = VR off-hand distance to the nock to grab the string. range = the owner's max shooter-to-hit distance. stickSeconds = how long stuck arrows stay.
bow._vrNote: VR hold: the shot axis and limb axis in the held pickup frame, offset (m) in the bow frame from the grip point. Tune live.

arrow.name: Arrow
arrow.desc: A cedar arrow with a forged broadhead. The bow takes them from your pockets or backpack. TESTING: weightless, stacks to 64.

health._note: Bleeds from hits: none in the raid's first bleedGraceSeconds, and at most one new bleed every bleedCooldownSeconds (the user, 2026-10-31: more arcadey, fewer bleeds).

xp._note: Per level: levelBase + levelStep*(L-1) + levelCurve*(L-1)^2. Raid XP is banked: full on escape, deathShare on death. Tuned 2026-10-24 for a player who dies 1 raid in 4: ~550 XP a raid (time out, x3 per minute once the power's on, searches, picks / pries, kills, fuel, power-on, secure rooms entered, hazard crates, extract + haul) -> level 50 in ~1,880 raids, ~690 hours at 22 min a raid. Level 50 is today's cap, not the final one.

skills._note: SP = level-1 (+ milestone quests) buys trunk nodes. CP from cpLevels (+ milestones) buys class nodes; another class's nodes cost offClassMult x and work in every class. wip nodes show COMING SOON and can't be learned yet. Respec is free below respecFreeUntil, then respecPerLevel x level. Classes are cube classes (Docs/CUBE_CLASSES.md): active = the cube power (C on desktop; VR: raise the cube, double-pull the trigger), rite = the seal rite, color = the cube's glow.

classes.name: Veilwalker
classes.desc: It never finds you. Everyone starts here.

apex.name: The Veil
apex.desc: In the veil it can't see you, and you leave no trail and no footsteps

active.name: Veil

second.name: Veil Step

classes.name: Keeper
classes.desc: Not this time. You take the hit off a teammate.

apex.name: Brace
apex.desc: A braced teammate shrugs off its next hit

second.name: Break the Hold

classes.name: Mender
classes.desc: Hold still. You put people back on their feet.

passive.desc: Field Medic (first node): medical items work faster, on anyone

apex.name: Patch

second.name: Field Surgery
second.desc: Capstone: at a downed teammate, hold 4 s - they're up, injured

classes.name: Brand
classes.desc: It runs from you. Your cube stuns hard and often.

passive.desc: Hard Light (first node): stun from less charge, for less, for longer

apex.name: Brand
apex.desc: Mark it, slow it, and your next stun is free

active.name: Brand
active.desc: Aim at the Xenosaurid within 20 m: marked for 20 s - the crew sees it through walls, it moves 20% slower, your next stun is free

second.name: Flare
second.desc: Capstone: a point-blank stun burst, no aiming (3 m around you)

quests._note: Docs/QUESTS.md v1. Accept up to maxActive at the contract boards; raid progress is banked only on escape. escape objectives: exit (any/dock/vent/hatch/road), powered (any/true/false), zones[] (+zonesAfterPower), carrying (item found this raid), haul (found value), minSanity, noHit. kill: shared within shareRange unless own; weapon any/knife/crowbar.

contracts._note: Daily contracts (QUESTS.md sec. 4): one per giver below, rolled per player at their level band (bands = min level of each band), re-rolled at 00:00 UTC unless in progress. Don't use a quest slot. Per-band arrays in objective pick that band's value; 0 = not offered at that band. pick: a random choice per roll ({PICK} in text); {N} = the count. coop: only rolled with someone else in the instance.

templates.title: Thin the Herd
templates.text: Dell here. Too many of them on the lot again. Put {N} down - doesn't matter whose swing does it.

templates.title: Fresh Bait
templates.text: The traps need bait. Bring me {N} Spoiled Meat. Something's been coming up the hill at night.
templates.done: That'll stink up the perimeter nicely.

templates.title: Nobody Stays In
templates.text: Somebody always ends up in one of those cages. Get them out. {N}. I don't care how, just get them home.
templates.done: Everybody home. That's the only number I keep.

templates.title: Back It Off
templates.text: Longskull flinches. Make it, {N} times, and come home.
templates.done: Good. It remembers who stood up to it. So do I.

templates.title: Out of Reach
templates.text: Come home {N} times without a cage on you. Watch the ceilings.

templates.title: Tissue Run
templates.text: {N} resin samples, sealed. I'm not asking which cage you scraped them off.
templates.done: Into the cold box they go. Thank you.

templates.title: Patch Them Up
templates.text: Bandage your mates, splint them, whatever it takes. {N} treatments on someone who isn't you. I want to see the habit.
templates.done: That's the job. That's the whole job.

templates.title: Workbench Shortfall
templates.text: Gus. I'm out of {PICK}. Need {N}. Don't ask what for.
templates.done: Perfect. Now get out of my light.

templates.title: Practice Makes
templates.text: Locks don't open themselves. Open {N} - pick them or pry them, I don't care.
templates.done: Told you. It's all in the wrist.

templates.title: Quiet Hands
templates.text: A cage is a lock with a person behind it. Pick one open for a mate, {N}. Quietly.
templates.done: See? It's all in the wrist. Same as I said.

templates.title: Keep Your Head
templates.text: Come back with your head on straight, {N} runs in a row if you can. Sanity {SANITY}+ when you walk in.

templates.title: Kit Work
templates.text: ANGEL NINE, YOUR KIT HAS WORK AT RIVERSIDE. FEED {N} INTO THE SEALS. OUT.

templates.title: Lights On
templates.text: ANGEL NINE, SEAL RIVERSIDE UP AND GET OUT ALIVE. {N} TIMES. OUT.

templates.title: Route Check
templates.text: ANGEL NINE, CONFIRM THE ROUTE. LEAVE BY {PICK}, {N} TIMES. OUT.

templates.title: Powered Sweep
templates.text: ANGEL NINE, WITH THE LIGHTS ON, SWEEP {N} CONTAINERS. EVERY DRAWER. OUT.

templates.title: Bulk Order
templates.text: Vic. I need {N} {PICK}. Volume, friend. Volume.

templates.title: Make It Worth It
templates.text: Walk out with ${HAUL} of loot - found on the run, not what you packed. Show me you can carry.

templates.title: Liquidity
templates.text: Sell me ${N} of shiny things. Quick-sell is fine, I'm not picky.

templates.title: Copper Trade
templates.text: Greyline. We need copper wire - {N} coils. Leave them with WREN and we'll leave you something you won't find in a cabinet.
templates.done: Received. Your end is in your pockets.

templates.title: Clean Chemistry
templates.text: {N} units of chemicals. In exchange: a medkit, packed properly. Refined.

templates.title: Plate for Plate
templates.text: Ceramic plates - {N}. We'll send back a vest that's been looked after.

templates.title: Circuit Exchange
templates.text: {N} electronics boards, intact. We pay in something rarer.
templates.done: Received. Handle the fragment with care.

templates.title: Resin for Residue
templates.text: Resin samples - {N}, sealed. We'll trade what the seals leave behind.

templates.title: Power for Light
templates.text: {N} batteries. You'll get a better light than the one you're squinting through.

dailies._note: Stamp-card dailies (Docs/QUESTS.md sec. 9): perDay rolled at 00:00 UTC from templates at your band (bands = min level of each band; a count of 0 = not offered there), weight = how often; easy ones guarantee band 1 a doable day; coop only with someone else in the instance, and at most one a day. Unfinished dailies are replaced at the reset. rerolls = free rerolls per slot per day. Progress counts on raid end - escape or death - except escape objectives. raidDone = your raid ended (escape or death) and a seal you fed closed that raid.

givers.name: ANGEL
givers.desc: Hillside's crew. The Warden, Doc, Rourke, Gus, Ines and Dell post work here.

givers.name: SURVIVOR NET
givers.desc: WREN, on the radio. Power, exits, site intel.

givers.name: OSTLER'S CONVOY
givers.desc: Vic Ostler. Shiny things and big hauls. No questions.

givers.name: CONTINUITY
givers.desc: A Continuity frequency, relayed through WREN's set. Pays best.

list.title: First Haul
list.text: Everyone gets one free run; that's been the rule since the Unsealing started. Go in, grab what you can carry, come back. Coming back is the part I care about.
list.done: You came back. That puts you ahead of half the people who've stood where you're standing.

list.title: First Aid
list.text: I can't send the good stuff out with people who bleed on it. Patch yourself up out there a few times. Show me you can keep your own blood in.
list.done: Fine. Rourke will let you have painkillers and splints. Don't make me regret it.

list.title: Scavenger
list.text: I don't sell packs to tourists. Work a site properly, every locker and crate, and bring me rope and tape. I'll stitch you a backpack for the counter.
list.done: Sixty containers. You're on the list. Packs are on the shelf when you've got the level.

list.title: Tools of the Trade
list.text: Fail-secure. Power dies, the locks stay shut. The staff locks are just locks. Learn the lockpick, learn the bar, and learn which one's quieter.
list.done: Keep the spare driver. They snap. You'll find out.

list.title: Hard Head
list.text: Everybody gets hit. The ones who come back are the ones who got hit and kept moving. Take some, live through it, and get me plastic and glue for helmets.
list.done: Hard hats are on the board. Wear one.

list.title: Shake It Off
list.text: Longskull doesn't want you dead. Not the first time. It wants you somewhere it can come back to. Get out of its tail three times, and get me plastic and glue for helmets.
list.done: Hard hats are on the board. Wear one. It won't stop the tail, but it'll stop the wall.

list.title: Riot Control
list.text: Thin them out. Up close, with the bar, so you know what it takes. And stay out of the dark corners in the ED.
list.done: Vests and sleeves are released. And if you hear about the Hollow Man, the thing that takes your arms, it's not a story. Keep your hands where your mates can see them.

list.title: Make It Flinch
list.text: You can't kill Longskull. Nobody has. But it flinches, and when it flinches it lets go. Make it flinch three times. And come home three runs without a cage on you.
list.done: Vests and sleeves are released. And if you hear about the Hollow Man, the thing that takes your arms, it's not a story. Keep your hands where your mates can see them.

list.title: Mess Stock
list.text: Thirty people eat beans every night. Bring me something with sugar in it, and one of those army meals, and I'll make it a night.
list.done: You should've seen their faces. Come by for a hot plate, any time.

list.title: Fresh Bait
list.text: Something's started coming up the hill at night. The yard traps need bait, and spoiled meat out of the cold stores does the job. Bring me three. Don't let Ines see it.
list.done: Perimeter's baited. Wash your hands. Twice.

list.title: Keep It Cold
list.text: Every one of us has been scratched. Nobody here turned. I want to know why. Those cages are seal stone with something grown over them. Scrape the resin off the bars, or off the vent rims, into a jar, and keep it cold if you can.
list.done: Two samples. It's a start. Bring more when you find them.

list.title: Steady Mind
list.text: I can see it on people when they come back, the ones who were alone in the dark. Come back to me with your head on straight a few times. Stick together, take a smoke, keep your light on.
list.done: That's better. That's a face I can feed.

list.title: Power Run
list.text: The site's gennies wake when the building does. Don't ask me how; I just know the lights come on and the locks let go. Get it lit and come home, twice. And no, the blast door at the end of the tunnel isn't on the same circuit. Nothing opens that.
list.done: Take a proper torch. The cheap ones die when you need them.

list.title: Lights On
list.text: ANGEL NINE, RIVERSIDE IS DARK. SEAL IT UP, WAKE IT, GET OUT. OUT.
list.done: RIVERSIDE SHOWING POWER ON THE NET. NICE WORK. OUT.

list.title: Kit Check
list.text: ANGEL NINE, YOUR KIT KNOWS THE WAY. DRAW, CARRY, FEED. CLOSE FOUR. DON'T TELL ME HOW. OUT.
list.done: FOUR LOGGED. RIVERSIDE GOES QUIETER EVERY TIME. THAT'S ALL I WANT TO KNOW. OUT.

list.title: Ways Out
list.text: NEED CONFIRMED EXITS AT RIVERSIDE. DOCK, VENT, PICKUP. ONE EACH. THE TRUCK DOESN'T WAIT. OUT.
list.done: THREE EXITS LOGGED. SHARING WITH THE NET. OUT.

list.title: Deep Survey
list.text: NOBODY HAS LOGGED THE RADIATION BUNKER AT THE BACK OF RIVERSIDE. LEAD WALLS, NO WINDOWS. REACH IT. TELL ME IT'S THERE. OUT.
list.done: BUNKER CONFIRMED. DOOR STILL ON ITS HINGES. NOTED. OUT.

list.title: No Questions Asked
list.text: Watches, rings, coins. Bring me shiny and I pay cash, better than anyone on the road. Don't ask me where it goes; I won't lie, so I won't answer.
list.done: Pleasure doing business. Come back when your pockets are heavy.

list.title: Hands Free
list.text: Headlamps. You need both hands in there. Get me batteries, wire and a board out of anything electrical.
list.done: Rourke has headlamps on the counter now.

list.title: Quiet Feet
list.text: Noise gets people killed. Come back clean five times, without a scratch, and bring leather and rope. I'll get boots made.
list.done: Quiet boots and runners, on the counter. Pick your trade-off.

list.title: Every Lock in Harrow
list.text: The best stock was locked away first. Drug cabinets, lockers, the doctors' desks. Open forty, pick some, break some, and you'll know every lock in Harrow.
list.done: Found a pair of tac gloves in the last lot. They're yours.

list.title: Field Medic
list.text: A syringe is worth more than a gold bar if it's your mate on the floor. Get them up. Patch them up. I want numbers.
list.done: Here, two syringes. Use them on someone who'd do the same.

list.title: Two Isn't a Pattern
list.text: Two isn't a pattern. Six is. And I need chemicals to keep them.
list.done: They're not all the same. The older ones are different. Here, medkits; you've earned the good shelf.

list.title: Dark Hours
list.text: No power, no lights, the pickup only. Come back with your head still yours, three times. I need to know what the dark does.
list.done: The ones who spend the longest inside are the ones hearing things. I don't think it's nerves. I think it's the first stage. Don't tell Ines I said that. Take this - it's a proper light. The trader will sell you more now.

list.title: Spare Key
list.text: KEEP RIVERSIDE BREATHING. EIGHT POWER-UPS, EIGHT RETURNS. THERE'S SOMETHING IN IT FOR YOU. OUT.
list.done: SPARE HATCH KEY, ONE OF THE RECALLED ONES. THE HATCH KEEPS IT ONCE YOU TURN IT. SPEND IT WELL. OUT.

list.title: Down the Hatch
list.text: RIVERSIDE HAS ONE CLEAR HATCH: THE FLOOR DRAIN IN PLUMBING. USE THE KEY. OUT.
list.done: HATCH ROUTE CONFIRMED. YOU'RE ONE OF A FEW. OUT.

list.title: Stock Take
list.text: WITH THE LIGHTS ON, TAKE STOCK OF RIVERSIDE'S MEDICAL CABINETS. TWENTY. EVERY SHELF. THE NET NEEDS TO KNOW WHAT'S LEFT. OUT.
list.done: INVENTORY RECEIVED. FOUND A RIOT HELMET IN THE TALLY. IT'S YOURS. OUT.

list.title: Names in the Ledger
list.text: RIVERSIDE MEDICAL RECORDS HELD THE ADMISSIONS. EVERY PATIENT ON THE WARDS WHEN THEY SEALED IT. TAKE A PENCIL, COPY WHAT YOU CAN, GET OUT. THREE RUNS. PEOPLE ARE STILL LOOKING. ...SO AM I. OUT.
list.done: NAMES ARE ON THE NET. FAMILIES ARE CALLING IN. HE WASN'T ON YOUR PAGES. KEEP LOOKING, WOULD YOU. OUT.

list.title: Somebody's Promise
list.text: WREN read me a list off the Net. Families of Riverside patients, asking for anything that came out. A ring, mostly. Something to bury. If you find one, bring it to me. Or don't; I know what Vic pays.

choices.done: Her name was on WREN's list. I'll see it gets to her. Sit down, I'll make you a plate.
Good gold, that. Here's a bit over, for the sentiment. I don't ask, you don't tell.

list.title: A Matched Set
list.text: I've got a buyer who wants a set: a ring, a camera, a gold chain. Not sold, handed over. He pays a premium for the set.
list.done: Your cut. And no, he's not from round here.

list.title: Heavy Lift
list.text: Somebody kept gold at Riverside. The patients' property safe, the director's, who knows. Bring a bar out the front door, the dock. The vent won't take it.
list.done: Keep the bar, sell it to me later. I just wanted to know it could be done.

list.title: Big Score
list.text: One run. One big run. Six hundred in your bags, all from the inside.
list.done: That's a run people hear about. Here's a little extra so they hear about me too.

list.title: Routine Collection
list.text: GOOD AFTERNOON. THIS IS GREYLINE, FIELD OFFICER LENNARD. CONTINUITY WILL COMPENSATE YOU FOR RESIN SAMPLES. TWO. THE PRICE IS GENEROUS. {DATE}.
list.done: RECEIPT ACKNOWLEDGED. YOUR COOPERATION HAS BEEN NOTED. GREYLINE.

list.title: Chain of Custody
list.text: FOUR FURTHER SAMPLES. PLEASE ALSO CONFIRM THE NAMES OF THE CREW PRESENT AT COLLECTION, FOR CHAIN OF CUSTODY. ROUTINE. GREYLINE.
list.done: THANK YOU. THE MEDICAL SUPPLIES ARE ISSUED WITH CONTINUITY'S COMPLIMENTS. WE WILL BE IN TOUCH WITH THE CREW LISTED. GREYLINE.

list.title: Supply Line
list.text: If we're going to arm this place properly, I need armour inserts, Kevlar, boards and a full toolbox. Then I can show you how to build a riot helmet yourself.
list.done: The pattern's yours. Ask Gus for bench time when the benches are up.

list.title: Four Hundred
list.text: Four hundred. That's how many beds Riverside had. I'm not saying it's the same ones. I'm saying it's a number.
list.done: You want to know how my crew died in the ED? Grey coveralls. Respirator harness. It came round behind us. That's all you get.

list.title: Still Standing
list.text: Four hundred beds at Riverside, and Longskull keeps its own count in there. Forty runs home without a cage. Make it flinch when it comes. Get out of its tail when it gets you anyway.
list.done: You want to know how my crew died in the ED? Grey coveralls. Respirator harness. It came round behind us. That's all you get.

list.title: Get Them Up
list.text: Twenty. Twenty people who'd be on a list if it weren't for you.
list.done: Hillside's alive because of people like you. I mean that literally.

list.title: Stop Asking
list.text: Fifteen more, the chemicals to fix them, and a surgical kit to cut them properly. Then I'll have an answer, or I'll stop asking.
list.done: Low dose. All of us. That's why nobody here turned: we're carrying it, just not enough. Continuity knows. That's why they want the names. Here's the syringe recipe. We'll need a lot of them.

list.title: Grand Tour
list.text: FULL WALK OF RIVERSIDE. TRAUMA ROOM, PHARMACY, SURGERY, THE CHAPEL. ONE RUN. WALK SOFT. SOMETHING IN THERE LISTENS. OUT.
list.done: FULL MAP ON THE NET. THE HUSH WON'T WORK RIVERSIDE. THEY SAY SOMETHING IN THERE IS LISTENING. NEITHER SHOULD YOU. OUT.

list.title: The Relay
list.text: HILLSIDE RELAY IS FAILING. BOARDS, WIRE, BATTERIES. THEN RIDE THE PICKUP OUT THREE TIMES SO THE DRIVER CAN CHECK THE LINE FROM THE STREET. OUT.
list.done: RELAY HOLDING. YOU JUST KEPT THREE OUTPOSTS ON THE AIR. MERIDIAN SENDS A PACK PATTERN. OUT.

list.title: Keeper of the Depot
list.text: RIVERSIDE IS THE NET'S BEST SOURCE SINCE THE UNSEALING STARTED. KEEP IT LIT. THIRTY MORE. OUT.
list.done: THIRTY LOGGED. GUS SAYS HE'S BEEN LISTENING. HE SAYS IF THE BLAST DOOR EVER OPENS, IT WILL TAKE A SECOND GENERATOR BIGGER THAN RIVERSIDE'S. OUT.

list.title: Seen It Twice
list.text: Eleven hundred in one run. I've seen it done twice.
list.done: Three. The truck goes toward the green zone next week; this lot rides with it. Don't look at me like that.

list.title: Records Retention
list.text: RIVERSIDE GENERAL: THE DIRECTOR'S OFFICE AND THE SECURITY OFFICE. CONFIRM THE FILES ARE INTACT AND THE LOCKDOWN PANEL IS UNTOUCHED. DO NOT READ THEM. GREYLINE.
list.done: CONFIRMED. FOR YOUR INFORMATION, THE SEAL ORDER CARRIES A COUNTY COUNTERSIGNATURE. MS ADAIR WILL REMEMBER. GREYLINE.

list.title: Sensitive Material
list.text: SIX FURTHER SAMPLES. AND WITH THE SITE POWERED, CONFIRM RIVERSIDE'S LAB COLD STORE: ITS DOOR, ITS SEAL, ITS CONDITION. FORM CD-14 REFERS. GREYLINE.
list.done: THE COLD STORE WAS REQUISITIONED IN YEAR ZERO FOR SENSITIVE MATERIAL, CONDITION GREY. IT IS CONTINUITY PROPERTY. PLEASE ACCEPT THIS MEDICAL PATTERN WITH OUR THANKS. GREYLINE.

stampCard._note: The stamp card (Docs/QUESTS.md sec. 9). Seasons of `weeks` from `start` (UTC date); only the card resets. free = stamps a new card starts with; guided = the once-per-account stamp for finishing the guided raid (outside the daily cap). A daily done = 1 stamp, weekendMult on Saturday / Sunday (UTC), at most dailyCap x (weekendMult on weekends) a day; over the cap a daily gives overflowPoints instead; a full card gives fullCardPoints, then afterFullPoints per daily. pointsPerStamp = points with each stamp. tiers[].at = stamps; items go to pockets / stash (paid like quest items), cosmetic = an id other systems read (HasCosmetic), {S} = the season number. backpay: true = this tier's reward changed mid-season; anyone who passed it before is sent the new reward once.

medUse._note: Medical items take time (MedUse): items.<id>.useSeconds (else defaultSeconds), divided by 1 + the medSpeed skill hook. A bar shows on your HUD; it stops if you move faster than cancelSpeed (a walk is fine, a run isn't), go down, lose the item, or get more than reach metres from the teammate you're treating.

exo._note: Exosuit battery: worn in a raid it drains over batteryMinutes (sprintDrain times faster sprinting); flat, the suit's help is off and deadSlow is the dead weight (an armoured suit's plates still count). Full again at the outpost; an Exo Cell (use exocell) puts in a fresh one. beltTilt: degrees the worn suit's belt piece leans its front down (the model has it rising toward the front).

outpost._note: DEPTH_PLAN part 2: each player's own outpost upgrades, bought at the workbench (OUTPOST). stash1..3: 60 / 72 / 96 slots; bench1: Military upgrades; bench2: benchDiscount off repairs and upgrades. Each {money, item: count} from the stash. residuePerSeal: Seal Residue dropped at a seal as it closes; fragmentChance: an Apex Fragment beside a hazard crate's counter item.

grades._note: DEPTH_PLAN part 2: armor and meds roll a grade (Worn / Standard / Refined / Military / Sealed) by these weights. shift.<container type> moves the roll up (each step: Worn x0.5, x1.5 per tier above Standard and for Sealed); Sealed only from the container types in sealed (the hazard crates, a seal's cache, the vault caches a closed seal opens). Per tier: armor stops 15% more of its hits and wears 15% less on a block; meds heal 25% more (a Refined+ bandage also keeps the wound closed, a splint heals).

depth._note: DEPTH_PLAN Phase 1. From armorFromRun runs on, worn armor can stop the Longskull's hit (its armor value x blockScale, on the region hit): a stagger (staggerSeconds at staggerSlow) instead of hurt. A block costs blockWear wear steps, an unblocked hit hitWear; 15 steps = broken (stops nothing). Wear is kept on the item between runs. The workbench repairs it: repairCostPerWear x base value per step. Phase 2, from limbsFromRun runs: limbFocus of each hit goes into the limb it raked (never below 15% of it from one hit) and fractureChance breaks it; a limb under soreBelow of its health is hurt (leg: slower and louder, arm: slower item use, softer melee), painkillers dull it. Phase 4, from downedFromRun runs: each bleeding limb takes 20% off the bleed-out (to half), badly hurt another 15%; a teammate's bandage on a downed player adds downedBandageSeconds (never past 1.5x), their medkit gets them up clean.

apex._spawnDistance: The lair is picked at least this far (m) from the raid spawns' middle (the clinic's Longskull started down the hall from the drop).
apex._formsNote: Xenosaurid (Apex2) only. CRAWL: chases at crawlChaseSpeed x anger boost, never above crawlMaxSpeed (= a sprint); anger builds only while crawling. A shock mine it crawls over (within mineRadius) staggers it for staggerSeconds and stands it up: chase at standChaseSpeed (a walk) + standAngerShare of the anger boost. It drops back to a crawl after standMin..MaxSeconds, or once it has chased for standChaseMin..Max seconds in total while standing. TAIL WHIP: when its target is whipMinRange..whipMaxRange away and in sight: a cue + whipWindup seconds turning after where you were whipLag seconds ago (whipTurnRate deg/s), then a straight strike whipLength long, whipWidth wide; whipCooldown between whips.
apex._note: Player walk 2.0, sprint 4.5. The apex starts a bit slower than a walk; anger builds 0..1 over angerMinutes of being out and adds up to angerMaxBoost (x1.8 = about 5 m/s chase at full: it outruns a sprint, so a long raid ends with someone caught). Downing someone it just hit drops anger by angerDropOnDown, each hit by angerDropOnHit. Each raid wakes one apex: secondChance = odds it is the Xenosaurid (Apex2) instead of Hollowface.
apex._crawlClipsNote: Crawl form clips (Blender, 2026-10-25): Crawl = the slow stalk, authored at crawlClipSpeed m/s (wandering plays it at speed / crawlClipSpeed, 1-2.5x); CrawlChase = the scuttle, authored at runClipSpeed. Execute = one 5 s clip (grab 0.55 s, strike 3.45 s, let go 3.97 s), the seat follows its throat point at the held player's own eye height.

hollowface._note: Hollowface v2, the stalker (Docs/HOLLOWFACE.md). STALK below huntAt: sneaks, keeps stalkMin..stalkMax m away, peeks from HFPeek markers (peekMin..peekMax s); only swipes when cornered (corneredRange, corneredDamage x). A flashlight on it while stalking: it flees fleeSeconds at skitterSpeed and gains lightCatchAnger + lightAnger per second lit. Loud noises: noiseAnger x radius/14 (max noiseAngerMax). Stared at while peeking for stareSeconds: stareAnger and it ducks out. HUNT at huntAt (or the squeeze): flashlights ignored, skitterSpeed x (1 + (anger - huntAt) x huntBoost), hits x huntDamage, a down rolls executeChance; huntLoseSeconds with nobody sensed -> anger afterHuntAnger, back to stalking. VISION: it only knows where you are from sight (sightRange m, sightCone deg; hunting huntSightRange / huntSightCone; peeking it looks out from its leaning face) or hearing; it works from your last known spot, goes there when the trail is 6 s cold, then roams. Nobody sensed for driftSeconds while stalking: a vague pull toward the nearest player (+- driftBlur m). It only peeks from a marker where the wall hides its body from you and its face sees you; if you leave its view for peekLostSeconds it ducks back.

debug._note: VRChat display names (exact, case-sensitive) that get the debug tools - the DEBUG tab in the gear screen and the backtick keys - even with RaidManager debugKeys off for release.

nest._note: The Xenosaurid's nests (ApexNests; Riverside v2/Build Apex Nests places the spots). Its grab-and-lift drags you off instead of killing you: kidnapShare of its full-anger executions, and downKidnapChance of any hit that would down you (time's-up executions still kill). At kidnapAt s into the Execute clip it lets go, the screen goes black for blackoutSeconds and you're pinned in a free nest - the nearest one at least minDistance m away (perRaid of the spots show each raid). A teammate within rescueRange m holds interact on the cocoon for rescueSeconds to cut you out; it's loud: a noise every noiseEvery s that husks within noiseRadius m and the Xenosaurid within apexHearRadius m come to (apex.noiseSeconds). Alone: the break-free dial, struggleNeed hits (struggleNeedKnife with a knife on you). Nobody gets you out in seconds s: you die. on 0 = no kidnaps (the old executions / downs).

hazardCrates._note: Hazard crates (ApexCrates): open from the raid start. An emptied crate is charged again at its panel: whoever starts it stays within holdRange m for chargeSeconds while it grinds - a noise every noiseEvery s, noiseRadius m (husks and the apex come) - then it holds a fresh apex item, and can be charged again only after cooldownSeconds. How many show: power.apexCrates.

seals._note: Seals + fonts replace generators + fuel on maps that have them (RaidSeals). More, quicker seals (2026-11-05, the user: a payoff every ~3-4 min of a 24 min raid; each closed seal opens its section's caged cache): about the same total cube work as before. Per crew size 1..13: count = seals picked (one per section where it can), hunger = full cubes of charge each seal drinks, fonts = fonts picked; minWalk = metres of walking (navmesh) every picked font keeps from every picked seal. The last seal closed spins the facility up (power.spinUpSeconds). required = seals that must close to power the facility; count places more as options (the user, 2026-11-10: "3x as much seals ... 4x more fonts ... same requirements just more options"). A section powers when any of its seals closes.

power._generatorNote: fuelNeeded[crew size - 1] cans in all, split across the raid's generators (power.generators of the map's candidates, the first takes the odd can); power comes on once every live generator is full. The apex wakes in a lair candidate at least apexGenDistance m from both.
power._secureNote: Each raid secureRooms of the candidate rooms (PowerDoor_<Room>) are secure: sealed until power-on, then open (or, at secureLockedShare odds per door, a lock to crack), lit, panels + stripes shown, secureCacheItems from the secure table dropped on their floor. Unpicked candidates are ordinary rooms (doors locked at candidateLockChance).
power._pourNote: Pouring a can: pourSeconds of level pouring / PlayerStats.PourSpeed (skills fuelSpeed, gear pct.pourSpeed, -35% per broken arm). The can drifts (balanceDrift, balanceInstability pushes it away from level); Q / E (VR triggers) push balancePush. The green zone (balanceZone wide) drifts round the gauge: a new spot every zoneHoldMin..zoneHoldMax s, moving zoneDrift per s. Full flow while the can stays inside it; tipping out of it spills (spillZone, default = balanceZone): spillLoss of a can lost, back to level, a noise of radius spillNoise that husks hear, and everyone pouring at that generator waits spillPause seconds. Each other player pouring at the same generator adds teamPourBonus, up to teamPourMax x.

exits._note: Road evac is the emergency exit: opens in the last roadSeconds of the raid (late ditch, not a free early out), then only with no backpack and at most roadKg carried (pockets only).

everyoneGift._note: A free gift for every player (new and returning), once per version, into their stash: {version, items: [{item, count}]}. All or nothing: a full stash waits until there's room. Raise the version to hand out a new list once more (the user, 2026-11-10: a Lifter and 2 Exo Cells).

playerGifts._note: One player's own gift, by VRChat display name: {version, items: [{item, count}]} into their stash once per version (like starterGift, but for one person). Raise the version to send the list again.

starterGift._note: Once per version, every player (new and returning) gets these items in their stash, no trade value. Raise version to hand out a new list once more. All or nothing: a full stash waits until there is room (the user, 2026-11-06).

starterKitStation._note: The outpost STARTER KIT button: starterKitItems for survivors up to maxLevel, once per raid, only what you don't carry, with no trade value (the user, 2026-10-31).

temperaments.desc: Walks at you, relentless but slow (~1.6 m/s)
Sprints once it has seen you (~4 m/s, close to your sprint)
Shuffles, then lunges for about a second every few seconds

husk._temperNote: Each spawn rolls a temperament (weights) and a +/- speedSpread jitter. walk/chase multiply walkSpeed/chaseSpeed; lurchers multiply chase by burst for burstFor s every ~burstEvery s.
husk._gaitNote: walkSpeed 0.45 m/s matches the shambling clips (ZOMBIE Starter walk 0.19 m/s, chase 0.42 m/s natural - Tools/Extraction/Fit Husk Gait); faster than a tree's fastest clip plays it faster (up to 2.2x). chaseSpeed 3 vs the hyper-chase clip's 2.55 m/s.
husk._grabNote: Grab: grabChance per attack in reach (never two husks on one player; per-husk grabCooldown after it lets go). The player is locked facing it; after grabBiteDelay it bites every grabBiteEvery (biteMin-Max, mostly chest). VR: stab the knife into its chest (grabZone m) grabStabsMin-Max times, pulling out between. Desktop: hit the dial's red zone that many times (locks.struggle*). A teammate's landed melee hit frees you at once. While held, only the grabber can hurt you. Costs sanity.grabLoss.
husk._footNote: Footsteps (same floor only): walking is heard within footWalk m, running footRun m; standing still / creeping is silent. Inside half that range a husk hunts you; further out it hurries over to look (walkSpeed x investigateMul). A light shone on a husk within lightSeen m (clear line, in the beam) draws it straight to you.

director._despawnNote: A husk more than despawnDist from every raider for despawnSeconds is taken out, so the drift (driftMin..driftMax) can walk one in near the team. Riverside v2 is one map: with 5000 here (left from the old teleport interior) the start fill parked every husk 60-240 m away and the cap kept any from coming near.

bloater._note: The fat husk (Morbid tank bodies; Tools/Extraction/Build Bloater Husks puts them on the last husks of the pool). Any enemies.husk key set here overrides it for bloaters only. chance = odds a spawn is a bloater (if one is free). weight_<temperament id> overrides that temperament's weight: slow and heavy, never a runner.

locks._note: Locked containers/doors. Pick: lockpick skill check (any "lockpick"-tagged tool). The needle spins round the dial non-stop (needleSpeed deg/s, +needleSpeedUp per pin); a zone (pickZone deg + skills / gloves / Mechanic passive, -pickZoneShrink per pin, never under pickZoneMin) appears ahead of it pickZoneFirstDelay s in, then pickZoneDelay s after each hit. Waiting never fails; a press outside the zone = missNoise radius m, breakChance to snap the pick, and you're kicked out. pinsByType / doorPins hits open it (pickHits skills take pins off container locks). Pry: crowbar, prySeconds (over the prySpeed perks), pryNoise radius m every 2 s, hovers hoverSeconds after. bonusRolls = extra loot rolls in a container that was locked. pryLeash = how far you can step from the crowbar before it stops (m). Per container: pickOnly / pryOnly odds.
locks._pinsNote: Hits (pins) a pick needs: by container type (pinsByType, else pickSuccesses), doors doorPins. Better locks take more pins; each pin shrinks the zone and speeds the needle.

insurance._note: Sidelined: insuring gear felt too safe. 1 = re-enable the INSURE buttons (kept once on death).

sell._note: Selling non-valuables one at a time: price = item value x the best share among its tags x rarityMult[rarity], never above maxShareOfBuy x the trader's own price for it (no buy-low/sell-high loops). noSell tags can't be sold. Valuables go through QUICK SELL at valuableRate.

shop._devNote: Entries with "dev": true are only shown to and sold to debug users (testing new items). Keep them at the END of the list. "qty" = how many one purchase gives.

salvage._note: Salvage (outpost workbench): items.<id>.salvage = the materials you get back. Rule: about half the craft recipe, nudged so the materials are worth 45-65% of the item. Buying from the trader and salvaging always loses money; salvaging loot and selling the parts beats selling the item by a few dollars at most (junk only). Valuables, food, meds, materials and the free rack flashlight don't salvage. See Docs/BALANCE.md.

_stackNote: items.<id>.stack: raw materials and monster parts stack to 6 (pockets, backpack, secure slot and stash). Weight and value count every unit; selling and hand-ins take one unit at a time.
_beamNote: items.<id>.beam for light items: range (m), angle (spot degrees), intensity, flicker 0-1 (how often it stutters). Tiers (close quarters, a beam not a pool of light): rack loaner 'flashlight' 10 m / 40 deg (free, worn out, flickers), headlamp 9 m / 50 deg (wider, hands-free), bought cheap_flashlight 13 m / 36 deg, tactical 20 m / 28 deg (narrow, bright). Every beam wears the flashlight cookie (hot spot, faint spill, black rim). The map bakes with almost no ambient light, so beam range is how far you can see.
_gripNote: items.<id>.grip: how the hand holds it (pickup orientation Gun). z = point along the item's length in its unit box (-0.5 = the -Z end; models are normalised with the thinner end at +Z), yaw 180 = held the other way round, roll = turned about its length (e.g. to bring a crowbar's hook upright), flip = VR trigger toggles reverse grip.

throw._note: Fragile items (tag 'fragile') can smash on landing: 0% at breakFrom m/s, 100% at breakAt. Set down gently (< 2.5 m/s) = no noise, no break. Desktop G toss lands at ~7 m/s (about 64%).

whatsNew: Something new hunts Riverside. Longskull climbs walls and ceilings, and moves through the vents. Look up. It doesn't kill you. It downs you, then takes you with its tail to a cage. Your crew has three minutes to get you out with a lockpick or a charged cube. Caught twice, you're gone. Mash Use to break free. A cube at 80% charge makes it flinch and let go. Your class is your cube now: Veilwalker, then Keeper, Mender and Brand as you level.
_whatsNewNote: WHAT'S NEW page after the credits on the join screen: the latest Docs/DEVLOG.md entry in short. Update it with each release.

lobby._note: Ready = seated in the outpost's drop cage (or READY at the raid terminal). Everyone in the outpost ready: the run starts after autoStartSeconds. Only some: the first one ready starts a seatWaitSeconds count (WREN: 'Cage is hot'), and when it runs out the ready ones go and the rest stay.

supporters._note: Ko-fi support in the world. on 0 = paused: the SUPPORTERS board and LINK terminal hide themselves and the supporter XP boost is off. Set on 1 (and put the two Ko-fi lines back into dataNotice, see Docs/DATA_NOTICE.md) to bring it back, no reupload. Paused until the world is out of Community Labs (the user, 2026-10-26).

dataNotice._note: The player-facing data notice (master copy and the facts behind it: Docs/DATA_NOTICE.md). join = the intro warnings page paragraph; pages = the ABOUT & DATA board. {contact} is replaced by contact. Keep it true to what the game sends and keeps. Edit here, sync both feed files, push: live in ~2 min, no reupload. Keep it true but non-mechanical: no anti-cheat details (the user, 2026-10-26).
dataNotice.contact: my Discord: discord.gg/cJGZrRPCfu (also on the ABOUT & DATA board's DISCORD button)
dataNotice.join: SEAL ORDER uses analytics: your play in this world is sent to me, tied to your VRChat name. I use it to see what's working and make the game better. The same connection helps deter reuploading. Records are deleted after 14 days.

pages.title: What is sent, and why
lines: Please turn on Allow Untrusted URLs to avoid bugs and get the best experience possible.
The game collects analytics on your progress, runs and earnings in this world, tied to your VRChat name, in order to improve the game.
I use them to see what's working and make the game better.
The same connection helps deter reuploading.
Nothing else is sent: no voice, chat or avatar.

pages.title: Your save
lines: Your level, money, stash and quests are saved by VRChat's own save system, on your VRChat account, for this world.
VRChat shares that save with the others in your instance.
Your progress is kept. If an update changes or removes something you own, it's converted into Early Access Points instead.

pages.title: Kept, and deleted
lines: Records of your play are deleted automatically after 14 days.
Your saved progress lives with VRChat. Season resets clear it in-world.
To have your records deleted: {contact}. Include your display name.
